snippet.title: Bob the Builder: Can We Fix It? (2001) [PC]  - Full Walkthrough  - 4K 60fps - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Welcome to a full 4K 60FPS playthrough of the nostalgic 2001 classic, Bob the Builder: Can We Fix It?!
Can we fix it? Yes, we can! 🛠️ Join Bob, Wendy, and the whole machine team—Scoop, Muck, Dizzy, Lofty, and Roley—as we tackle a variety of fun-filled puzzles and missions. From fixing leaky plumbing puzzles and saving porcupines to popping bubbles and racing Travis the tractor, we are diving into all the nostalgic action in beautiful 4K.

If you enjoyed this trip down memory lane, hit that Like button, drop a Comment letting us know your favorite mini-game, and Subscribe for more 4K retro gaming longplays and walkthroughs!
